caption: The drawing features a single, lidded vessel—likely a cup or tankard—with a rounded body, a flared base, and a domed lid topped with a small finial. It has an ornate handle, curving outward with a decorative flourish. The vessel is rendered in grayscale, using various pencil or graphite shading techniques to suggest its metallic surface and three-dimensional form. The main object is enclosed within a rectangle, and in the upper left corner, there is a smaller square containing an emblem or crest. This emblem consists of a shield with intertwined letters inside, surrounded by a decorative border, and a ribbon or bow at the top, with what appear to be two crossed branches below. The background is a plain, off-white or slightly yellowed paper, and the drawing is signed "L. Drozdoff" in the lower right corner.
title: Silver Mug
